Hyperlinking Policy
Links to external websites/portals
At many places in this website **and associated portals (including myAadhaar)** , you shall find links to other websites/portals. The links have been placed for your convenience. UIDAI is not responsible for the contents and reliability of the linked websites and does not necessarily endorse the views expressed in them. Mere presence of the link or its listing on this **website or associated portals** should not be assumed as endorsement of any kind. We cannot guarantee that these links will work all the time and we have no control over availability of linked pages. When you select a link to an outside website, you are leaving the UIDAI website **or associated portals** and are subject to the privacy and security policies of the owners/sponsors of the outside website. UIDAI cannot authorize the use of copyrighted materials contained in linked websites. Users are advised to request such authorization from the owner of the linked website. UIDAI does not guarantee that linked websites comply with Indian Government Web Guidelines. Links to UIDAI website by other websites
We do not object to you linking directly to the information that is hosted on this site **or associated portals** and no prior permission is required for the same. However, we would like you to inform us about any links provided to this Portal **website or associated portals** so that you can be informed of any changes or updations **updates** therein. Also, we do not permit our pages to be loaded into frames on your site. The pages belonging to this site must load into a newly opened browser window of the User. This web site is **and associated portals (including myAadhaar)** are brought to you by the UIDAI (UIDAI). While surfing through this site **or associated portals** , you will come across directories and links to Government and Private Organizations. The contents of these sites are not to be construed as a responsibility of or an endorsement by the Authority and are owned by the respective organizations, which may be contacted for any further information or suggestion. Material featured on this website may be reproduced **and associated portals (including myAadhaar) may be reproduced** free of charge. However, the material has to be reproduced accurately and not to be used in a derogatory manner or in a misleading context. Wherever the material is being published or issued to others, the source must be prominently acknowledged. However, the permission to reproduce this material shall not extend to any material which is identified as being copyright of a third party. Authorization to reproduce such material must be obtained from the departments/copyright holders concerned.
